[[File:Ramone.png|thumb|250px|Ramone]] '''Ramone''' (Japanese: '''リキオー''' ''Rikiō'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==History== Ramone debuted in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and was {{an|Dawn}}'s first opponent. However, he was defeated by her and eliminated from the tournament. He made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]], and [[Freddy O'Martian]]. In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Ramone competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, meaning he had made it through the first round. In ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', he appeared once again on the screen of the Vertress Conference, now showing the match-ups for the last sixteen, meaning that he had made it through the second and third rounds. In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', it was revealed he had made it through the fourth round as well. In the quarterfinals, he battled [[Antonio]] and won. In the semifinals, he battled [[Dino]] but lost, placing him in the Top 4. Afterwards, he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference. ==Pokémon== ===In rotation=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ramone |pkmn=Stoutland |img=Ramone Stoutland.png |type1=Normal |epnum=BW090 |epname=Jostling for the Junior Cup! |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Stoutland}} is the first Pokémon Ramone is known to have on hand. It was used in the first round of the Junior Cup but lost to [[Dawn's Piplup]]. It was also used off-screen in ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'' in Ramone's battle with [[Antonio]]. None of Stoutland's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ramone |pkmn=Tranquill |img=Ramone Tranquill.png |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |epnum=BW104 |epname=Mission: Defeat Your Rival! |desc={{p|Tranquill}} was seen briefly with Ramone in front of a [[Pokémon Center]] in ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]''. None of Tranquill's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ramone |pkmn=Chandelure |img=Ramone Pokémon.png |type1=Ghost |type2=Fire |epnum=BW108 |epname=A Unova League Evolution! |desc={{p|Chandelure}} was used in Ramone's quarterfinal match against [[Antonio]]. It managed to stay undefeated during the battle, and it did a victory pose with its Trainer after he won the match. None of Chandelure's moves are known.}} ===Scoreboard Pokémon=== Ramone was shown to have these Pokémon briefly on the scoreboard during the [[Vertress Conference]].
